reportSemantics: Report data is engineering-owned under VER-14; no envelope key, common cause or station identity is added.
A report has exactly the independently admitted ruleId/caseId pairs; reject missing, duplicate and unexpected identities before iterating.
ruleId resolves here; caseId is frozen by the test-owned specimen admission before checker implementation for that case.
Every failed row uses that rule findingCode; all independently detectable findings remain visible. A single-finding cap is not imposed.
For a single-rule negative, every unrelated evaluable row remains passed. Prerequisites not evaluated remain not_run with a reason; never invent observations.
A passed row requires actual evidence at its promised proof layer. Schema validity of a report alone never establishes proof.
not_run, missing, skipped and timed_out are unproved, never passed or declared_unreachable.
declared_unreachable requires reviewed impossibility and evidence; it is not a passing execution.
Pin exact counts by status in every admitted specimen. Do not infer qualification from an empty or partial report.
Messages are bounded, redacted explanations of the violated field/correlation and repair direction; no byte-exact diagnostic prose oracle.
This report is not a universal evidence schema or a qualification summary for all 49 V rows.

noReplayProtocol.layer: real checker and target processes with independent counter readback
noReplayProtocol.guidance: Separate inspection of target effects, never target replay. Reader unchanged never asserts the executed target was unchanged.
noReplayProtocol.validTwin: Same single target execution and increment, but emit admitted valid output; reader succeeds and counter stays 1.
noReplayProtocol.sensitivityControl: Introduce automatic second target execution after invalid output; counter becomes 2 and the same harness must fail.

Admitted disposable target specimens produce real envelope-bearing exits 1, 4 and 75, each compared to its independent expected cause/exit, not merely envelope self-agreement.

A fixture-only minor cannot remove, rename, require an older key, reinterpret older absence, change meaning or add a common cause. Future field table must be separately frozen before checker compatibility code.

Full row report transport for a refused invocation is intentionally unspecified. VER-10/11 require message details and data:null; VER-14 does not require a refusal sidecar or stderr report. No transport is invented here.
